title: 第四章 良子第五章 寻找第六章 强化
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
洗完澡后。
陈洛将半干的头发捋顺，提着脸盆走进更衣室。
“嘶——好大。”
“卧槽大舅哥，以前怎么没发现你这么大？”
“首先，我不是男同。其次，我能摸摸吗大舅哥。”
“滚。”
啪！
陈洛一巴掌拍掉咸猪手，扭头看向镜中的自己。
以前他不喜欢运动，肌肉并不明显。
往往只在特定角度下，能看到些许形状。
而现在，
吸收【肌肉强化】词条后，陈洛即便站着不动，体表一块块肌肉轮廓都是泾渭分明，清晰可见，如同常年锻炼的健身人士。
简单观察身体的变化后，陈洛收回目光，转而将注意力落向周围。
他观察着来往的每一个的学生，试图找到新的词条。
从离开宿舍，到洗完澡这段时间，陈洛观察了将近一两百人。
其中不乏一些他认识，并明确知晓对方有突出特质的人，却仍旧一无所获。
难道词条的生成机制，与个人特质没有直接联系？
又或者说，是缺少某种特定因素？
怀揣疑惑，陈洛一边换衣服，一边想着待会到各个宿舍串串门，多观察观察。
“同学，麻烦让下。”

低沉的声音从旁边传来。
一坨白花花的肉团从他身前挪过，像是没穿衣服。
陈洛瞳孔紧缩，下意识便要偏开视线。
但他随后发现，是自己看错了。
眼前这个胖子，并非没穿内裤，只是肚子的肥肉过于臃肿下垂，将内裤硬生生遮住罢了。
他转而看向对方的头顶，例行检查词条的存在。
【脏腑强化：脏腑机能+50%】
【是否复制词条？】
映入眼帘的字眼，让陈洛惊喜的同时，眼中亦闪过错愕。
他观察着眼前的胖子。
其后背密密麻麻的鸡皮肤，显然是皮脂分泌旺盛，堵塞毛孔所致。
腋窝边缘以及后颈处，则有明显的黑棘皮，这是胰岛素抵抗的明显标准，亦是糖尿病前兆之一。
仅仅只是走两步路，换个衣服，陈洛甚至在相隔两三米的距离里，听到对方沉重的呼吸声。
这样的人身上，竟然会有脏腑强化的词条，这让陈洛愈发怀疑，自己对于词条生成机制的判断，可能是错误的。
【是】
疑惑归疑惑。
丝毫不妨碍他复制词条。
content_en:
After taking a shower.
Chen Luo smoothed down his half-dried hair and walked into the dressing room carrying the washbasin.
“Hiss—it’s so big.”
"Damn it, uncle, why didn't I realize you were so big before?"
"First of all, I'm not a gay. Secondly, can I touch you, uncle?"
"Get lost."
Snap!
Chen Luo slapped his hand away and turned to look at himself in the mirror.
He didn't like to exercise before and his muscles were not obvious.
Often only certain shapes can be seen at certain angles.
And now,
After absorbing the entry [Muscle Strengthening], even if Chen Luo stood still, the outlines of the muscles on his body were distinct and clearly visible, just like a bodybuilder who exercised all year round.
After briefly observing the changes in his body, Chen Luo withdrew his gaze and turned his attention to his surroundings.
He observed every student coming and going, trying to find new entries.
From leaving the dormitory to taking a shower, Chen Luo observed nearly one to two hundred people.
There were many people he knew and knew clearly that they had outstanding qualities, but he still found nothing.
Isn't the entry generation mechanism directly related to personal characteristics?
Or is there a certain factor missing?
With doubts in mind, Chen Luo changed his clothes and thought about visiting various dormitories later to observe more.
"Classmate, please give way."
A deep voice came from the side.
A lump of white flesh moved past him, as if he had no clothes on.
Chen Luo's pupils tightened and he subconsciously looked away.
But he later discovered that he had seen it wrong.
The fat man in front of him was not wearing no underwear, but the fat on his belly was too bloated and saggy, so his underwear was covered by it.
He turned to look at the top of the other person's head, checking the existence of the entry as a routine.
[Strengthening of organs: organ function +50%]
[Do you want to copy the entry? 】
The words that caught his eye surprised Chen Luo, and at the same time, he was also stunned.
He observed the fat man in front of him.
The dense chicken skin on his back is obviously caused by strong sebum secretion, which blocks the pores.
There are obvious acanthosis nigricans on the edge of the armpits and the back of the neck, which is an obvious standard of insulin resistance and one of the precursors of diabetes.
Just taking two steps and changing clothes, Chen Luo even heard the other party's heavy breathing from a distance of two or three meters.
Such a person would actually have entries for strengthening the internal organs, which made Chen Luo increasingly suspicious that his judgment on the entry generation mechanism might be wrong.
【Yes】
Doubts are doubts.
This did not prevent him from copying the entries.
